newsitem.title: USA: Consumers to sell unit, liquidate.
newsitem.headline: Consumers to sell unit, liquidate.

text.p: Consumers Financial Corp said on Tuesday that it reached a tentative deal to sell its credit insurance operations to Life of the South Corp, a Georgia-based insurance holding company, and that it plans to liquidate its remaining operations.
Consumers Financial said its previous agreement to merge with LaSalle Group Inc has been terminated after LaSalle could not secure financing.
The selling price for the credit insurance operation is contingent upon the premiums produced by Consumers' current accounts and will be paid over a five-year period, Consumers said in a statement.

During this period, Consumers will liquidate its remaining assets and pay all creditors and preferred stockholders, the company said. All remaining assets will be distributed in cash to Consumers' common stockholders, it said.
